findings.msg: The explanation treats the strength of a litotes as fixed. «Nicht ganz unproblematisch» can mean «somewhat problematic» and does not necessarily imply that the negotiations were difficult or seriously problematic; «nicht schlecht» can also express moderate approval. Explain that context and intonation determine the intended strength, and qualify the corresponding table and theory entries.

«Zu + infinitive» with «sein» can express possibility as well as necessity. In «Die Ergebnisse sind mit Vorsicht zu interpretieren», the interpretation is a recommendation or requirement arising from context, not an inherent meaning of the construction. Qualify the note accordingly.
